scope.M1_M10: freeze finite capability union: arithmetic, muxes, registers, buffers, clock/reset, controllers and storage
scope.M11_M12: permanently bind products to already fabricated routes/commands/constants; cannot add active circuits
scope.external_memory_this_round: not implemented or assessed; no EXT/DMA/spill generated; future integration preserved

PROVE_SCHEMA.meaning: Bind family, semantic role, record field, operation and provenance; no runtime role header.

PROVE_NUMERIC.meaning: Bind Fin/Fout, signedness, range, rounding, saturation and algorithm error acceptance.

BIND_PRODUCT.meaning: Select an already fabricated port/route, operation ROM constants, count and owner using M11/M12.

SELECT_ROUTE.meaning: Real prebuilt MUX/demux and phase select or one dedicated point-to-point net. Exclusive valid never permits shorting push-pull outputs.

HOLD_HANDSHAKE.meaning: Capture a response before advancing source; hold payload/sideband until accepted; filter ACK/error/saturation.

PACK_LANES.meaning: Field selection, sign/zero extension, split/concatenate, lane order and valid-tail handling; does not alter numeric units.

NATIVE_OP.meaning: Reuse a proved existing op (e.g. M5, E10/E13, N3/N6) only when its exact formula/layout matches; transport/owner glue remains separate.

ONCHIP_STORE.meaning: Bounded S allocation, typed snapshot, write ACK consumption and credits; this round has no EXT/DMA/spill path.

LIFECYCLE.meaning: Unique owner, fork reference counts, JOIN companions, RESUME same context, REENTER new context and storage lifetime.

FIELD_JOIN.meaning: Select record fields and collect explicitly supplied companions/ROM constants; no invented scores, gamma or inject.

EXP_REPLAY.meaning: Keep exact EXP lineage and factor context, wait FINALIZE, issue N6; never bitcast EXP into probability.

CONTROLLED_FIELD.meaning: Unique command owner validates integral fields, bounds, reserved bits and authorized updates. Runtime ID address formation needs prebuilt checked address logic.

GATHER_DATA.meaning: Resolve ID into original score/record/data using an explicit table and layout; ID alone does not contain those data.

LOADER_CAPTURE.meaning: For serial same-S reentry, candidate 1024B snapshot, both A/B sinks, then done then ordinary writes; not existing loader storage.

T_BATCH_SPOOL.meaning: Same physical T reentry needs complete old batch, max6144B S spool, ACKs, last take/release, then new BEGIN; distinct T need not force this.

MISSING_NUMERIC.meaning: Only if no exact native-op/wiring proof exists: missing wide arithmetic/normalization/inject/etc. Freeze before M1-M10 or reject this product mapping.

conditional_action_rules.NATIVE_OP: Only if a concrete op formula, unit, shape and capacity match is proved; no forced extra E/NUM hop.
conditional_action_rules.MISSING_NUMERIC: Only if required arithmetic cannot be implemented by exact existing ops/wires; legal requirement remains a capability gap.
conditional_action_rules.ONCHIP_STORE: Only if staging/replay/fork/reentry needs it; finite S slots and no spill fallback this round.
conditional_action_rules.FIELD_JOIN: Only if record fields or independently supplied companions are consumed by chosen op.
conditional_action_rules.GATHER_DATA: ID_RESOLVE only; ID_AS_INT or transport need no score gather.
conditional_action_rules.LOADER_CAPTURE: Only serial same-S reentry with all A/B drained; direct legal loader sinks may avoid extra1024B.
conditional_action_rules.T_BATCH_SPOOL: Only same physical T reentry/full-batch lifetime; distinct T/direct sink evaluated separately.

source_role_overrides.M.result64: Keep fullS64 or prove exact M5-subset/native conversion; low32/16 selection alone is not a numeric conversion.
source_role_overrides.S.write_echo: Capture typed echo, consume ACK, free response slot before forwarding/reentry; not an independent read port.
source_role_overrides.S.loader_A_and_B: Drain both streams and done. Serial same-S reentry needs candidate1024B snapshot; native loader stores only192B queues and has no done-abort shortcut.
source_role_overrides.T.committed_word: Same physical T reentry uses complete batch snapshot with max6144B S reservation; distinct T or source-preserving routes must be evaluated separately.
